data.title: XMAX Faces Nasdaq Non-Compliance, Plans Remediation Path
data.description:
XMAX ( (XMAX) ) just unveiled an announcement.

On September 10, 2026, XMAX, Inc. disclosed that it had received a notification from Nasdaq’s Listing Qualifications Department stating the company is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5635(d, which requires prior shareholder approval for certain discounted share issuances of 20% or more of pre-transaction outstanding shares. The non-compliance stems from a December 19, 2025 Securities Purchase Agreement and subsequent discounted private placements in March and April 2026, which together exceeded the 20% threshold without shareholder approval, though the notice does not immediately affect XMAX’s Nasdaq listing.

The company has until October 26, 2026 to submit a plan to regain compliance, with the possibility of up to 180 days of extension if Nasdaq accepts its remediation strategy. If Nasdaq does not accept the plan, XMAX can request a hearing and appeal to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel, and the company has stated its intention to pursue the necessary steps to regain compliance while its stock continues to trade normally during the compliance period.
